name: First-time-right creative QA (run before delivering)
rule: Do not deliver until every applicable item is PASS or N/A with reason. Mechanical lint-pass overrides self-scores.

gates.ask: Platform, niche, offer, funnel, production tier, and CTA are explicit or assumed via brief-defaults with Assumptions listed?
gates.fail_if: Guessed without stating assumptions; or >3 blocking questions with no package

gates.ask: Primary + challenger retrieved; retrieve warnings acknowledged?
gates.fail_if: Freewheeled style with no pattern id or ignored match_quality:none

gates.ask: One job-to-be-done in one sentence?
gates.fail_if: Multiple jobs or feature laundry

gates.ask: S0–S3 stated; no product pixels without refs at S0?
gates.fail_if: Product hero film with no stills and no REQUEST rows

gates.ask: Product/character sheets inlined with provenance tags or REQUEST gaps?
gates.fail_if: Generating product/talent ads with no sheet and no request for refs

gates.ask: Claim & asset ledger complete; every metric/review/price/geo tagged?
gates.fail_if: Invented proof or untagged claims; AI persona personal-results endorsement

gates.ask: 0–3s works muted and does not open on logo?
gates.fail_if: Logo-first or abstract brand talk in first 3s

gates.ask: If viral/trend: format recognizable in ≤1.5s?
gates.fail_if: Trend claimed but format not signaled

gates.ask: Timed script + Render plan units with durations ≤ model max?
gates.fail_if: Wall of undated copy or single 45s prompt for a 15s-capable model

gates.ask: Render plan with unit ids, real MCP roles, Image-N bindings, audio path?
gates.fail_if: Made-up roles (product_hero file paths) or missing clip split

gates.ask: Exactly one primary CTA in the cut?
gates.fail_if: Slash-menu CTAs in one cut

gates.ask: Landing/bio/store promise mirrors the hook?
gates.fail_if: Offer/SKU/geo mismatch

gates.ask: Audio/faces/footage rights + synthetic disclosure addressed?
gates.fail_if: Trending sound assumed free for ads OR AI talent hidden as real customer

gates.ask: policy-precheck.json + claim-firewall niche rules applied?
gates.fail_if: Regulated niche with no category/disclaimer/blocked-format check

gates.ask: Checked anti-patterns + mistakes + slop lexicon?
gates.fail_if: Skipped QA

gates.ask: Pattern output_contract deliverables present?
gates.fail_if: Missing shot list/captions/matrix when required

gates.ask: Serious brands: viral + high-production with same JTBD/claims/sheets; separate aspect generates?
gates.fail_if: Only one track for serious brand without stated reason; or center-crop twin

gates.ask: Aspect, captions, length fit platform?
gates.fail_if: Wrong aspect dumped without vertical cut

gates.ask: Rubric with evidence for 5s, caps respected, 2–3 failures, A/B/C?
gates.fail_if: Empty critique or uniform uncited 5s

gates.ask: If connected: frame audit + receipt. If handoff: NOT_RENDERED explicit?
gates.fail_if: Claims rendered PASS without job ids

gates.ask: node scripts/lint-package.mjs <package.md> exits 0 (or manual same rules)?
gates.fail_if: Lint failures ignored; self-score used to override

gates.ask: Checked LAST-VERIFIED.md or warned if stale >90 days; probed models if connected?
gates.fail_if: Blind outdated model IDs

dimensions.name: Desire or proof
dimensions.5: Sensory desire OR credible USER/ASSET proof

score_rubric.ship_rule: Ship if lint-pass + all dimensions ≥4 (after caps), or user accepts draft with listed risks. Self-critique mandatory either way. Lint overrides vibes.
